extraction_limitations: The chapter delegates the full ADA evidence-grading definitions and development methodology to the separate Introduction and Methodology, which is not part of this source file.
The chapter is a secondary guideline source. Cited trial and observational results require direct reading of the cited publication before reuse as primary-study atoms.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
No bibliography entry was treated as an evidence atom.
